item.title: THE CLASSROOM OF A BLACK CAT AND A WITCH Anime Reveals Ending Theme Ahead Of April Premiere
item.description: Spira Spica will perform the ending theme "Tune Up" for The Classroom of a Black Cat and a Witch anime, joining ASCA's opening track "Cusp" as the series prepares for its April 2026 debut.

item.title: Crunchyroll Manga Adds 30 New Titles From J-Novel Club To Its App Library
item.description: Crunchyroll has expanded its manga app with 30 new light novel adaptations and manga series licensed from J-Novel Club, the new reads are filled with many genres for fans of all types.

item.title: The Boston Red Sox Announce Third Annual ONE PIECE Theme Night In May With Exclusive Bomber Jacket
item.description: Toei Animation and the Boston Red Sox have confirmed the third One Piece Theme Night at Fenway Park in May of this year, the event will have a limited-edition Straw Hat Crew bomber jacket giveaway.

item.title: DIGIMON BEATBREAK Adds VTuber Hakui Koyori To Cast As Yume Ikuhara And Tinkermon
item.description: Hololive VTuber Hakui Koyori joins the Digimon Beatbreak cast, voicing both human girl Yume Ikuhara and her Digimon partner Tinkermon in episode 19 that debuts this Sunday.

item.title: THAT TIME I GOT REINCARNATED AS A SLIME Movie Drops New Scene From Film Ahead Of Premiere This Month
item.description: That Time I Got Reincarnated as a Slime – Tears of the Azure Sea anime movie has dropped a new short clip of Rimuru and friends soaring to a resort island on their adventure.

item.title: ALYA SOMETIMES HIDES HER FEELINGS IN RUSSIAN Anime Season 2 Delayed To 2027 For Higher Quality
item.description: The second season of Alya Sometimes Hides Her Feelings in Russian anime series has been pushed back from its planned 2026 debut to 2027, with Dōga Kōbō citing a focus on improving production quality.

item.title: Seven Seas Licenses SLEEPING IDIOT / NEMURUBAKA Manga By HEAVENLY DELUSION Creator Masakazu Ishiguro
item.description: Seven Seas Entertainment has acquired the English rights to Sleeping Idiot, a heartfelt slice-of-life manga from Masakazu Ishiguro, set for release in November 2026 under the Seven Seas GL label.

item.title: TERMINATOR ZERO Creator Confirms Netflix Has Canceled The Anime Series
item.description: Netflix has canceled Terminator Zero despite critical acclaim, ending its standalone anime story after one season while leaving hints of a larger saga.

item.title: Science Saru's THE GHOST IN THE SHELL Anime To Stream On Prime Video
item.description: Prime Video will serve as the global streaming home for Science Saru's highly anticipated The Ghost in the Shell anime, which is scheduled to release this July.

item.title: ONE PIECE Actor Taz Skylar Shares Extreme Fasting Routine Behind Sanji Transformation For Season 2
item.description: One Piece actor Taz Skylar stunned fans by revealing the extreme fasting and grueling workouts he did to physically become Sanji for Season 2.
